messages:
emily-product: Quick sync — I'm proposing a rollout plan for the region-aware graceful-degrade feature (model switch + fallback orchestration). Goal: keep customer-facing latency and error SLOs intact during model variant transitions. High-level idea: per-region stepped canaries + A/B fidelity checks + automatic fallback to a pinned stable variant on SLA breach or quality regression.

marta: 👍 sounds reasonable. two asks: (1) prioritize paying customers / enterprise slices first, (2) keep an immediate opt-out per-tenant.

samir: Question — what are our guardrail metrics? p95 latency, 5xx rate are obvious, but do we want an embed/semantic-fidelity signal (e.g., eval prompts rerun + similarity delta)? Also what's the target bake time per step?

emily-product: Good q. Proposed KPIs: p95 latency (region), 99th latency for large sequences, 5xx rate, request error rate, and a tiny fidelity set (20 prompts) with automated diffs and a threshold on semantic delta (cosine drop > 0.08 triggers rollback). Bake windows: 4h at 1%, 6h at 5%, 12h at 20%, then open. Can be adjusted if telemetry noisy.

devon: For implementation we should use a two-layer flag: global flag + per-region percentage + per-tenant overrides. Example config (devops-friendly):

```yaml
feature_flags:
  region_degrade:
    enabled: false
    regions:
      eu-west: 0.01
      us-west: 0.01
    per_tenant_overrides: {}
rollout_policy:
  steps: [0.01, 0.05, 0.2, 1.0]
  bake_hours: [4, 6, 12, 0]
  auto_fallback: true
  fallback_variant: stable-v1
```

devon: Also add header-level routing so we can route sampled traffic to shadow variant for continuous validation (no customer impact).

samir: How do we detect fidelity regressions fast? Running the 20 eval prompts on every step might be slow. Maybe run them as a background shadow job and use rolling average with anomaly detection + manual approval if close to threshold.

emily-product: Agreed — shadow-run with rolling average and an alert when the delta crosses 0.06 for 2 consecutive checks. Manual approval required if it crosses 0.08.

marta: Ops/runbook note: must include a clear kill-switch path: immediate global off, per-region rollback, per-tenant opt-out. Also add a customer comms template for enterprise teams when we ramp them.

sre-ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started for eu-west at 1% (region_degrade) — ts=1778881245. Monitoring dashboards: product/canary-region-degrade and infra/latency-stream.

emily-product: Action items: (1) @devon open PR with flag schema + rollout defaults, (2) @samir add the fidelity eval harness + shadow-run pipeline, (3) @marta draft enterprise comms + opt-out flow, (4) SRE please wire the canary dashboard and kill-switch. Aim to have PR + dashboards by EOD Wed.

samir: I'll stub the eval harness today, will add the rolling-average detector.

devon: Will put up the PR with config + a small e2e test that simulates gradated traffic.

emily-product: Great. We should also document launch criteria: (a) no p95 regressions > 10% for two steps, (b) 5xx rate unchanged (<0.5% delta), (c) fidelity delta <0.06 rolling or manual approval if between 0.06–0.08. If any fail, auto-fallback to `stable-v1` and page on-call.

marta: +1. Also recommend a 72h post-open monitoring window at 100% before we consider the rollout complete for that region.

emily-product: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short PR checklist and tag stakeholders.
